caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a rectangular top, composed of multiple horizontal planks, each with a visible wood grain texture. The top surface has slight irregularities and a small dark spot on the right side. The table stands on four straight legs connected by horizontal supports. There are two decorative crossbars between the side legs, each featuring a zigzag or scalloped edge design. The wood appears to be colored in shades of light brown and muted pink, with darker tones accentuating the shadows and wood grain details. The background is plain and uncolored, making the table the sole focus of the composition. In the bottom right corner, there is a signature or inscription that reads, "Mabel G. Claflin – Thos. N. M."
title: Small Table
